summary: Recent advancements in AI showcase significant innovations and collaborations across various sectors. Google has enhanced its Search capabilities with new features for travel planning, enabling users to book hotels and track airfare prices using AI. Meanwhile, OpenAI is partnering with Thailand's MHESI to foster AI startups in health, wellness, and education through an accelerator program. Additionally, tools like Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash offer developers greater customization, while Diffusion PDF allows users to generate images directly within PDF files. The introduction of the Open ASR Leaderboard's first language from the Global South further emphasizes the importance of diversity in AI applications.
recommendations: Focus on the most impactful items that highlight significant advancements or collaborations in AI and tech.
Eliminate items that discuss less relevant topics or that do not contribute to the overall narrative of innovation and development in AI.
Ensure that the summary captures a diverse range of applications and tools, showcasing both technical advancements and user-oriented features.

items.original: The Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Its First Global South Language
items.rewritten: The Open ASR Leaderboard has introduced its first language from the Global South. This addition highlights the growing recognition and inclusion of diverse languages in automatic speech recognition systems.

items.original: 3 new ways to plan and book travel in Search. Book hotels and track airfares, plus view miles and rewards with AI Mode in Google Search.
items.rewritten: Google has introduced three new features in Search to assist with travel planning and booking. Users can now book hotels, track airfare prices, and view their miles and rewards using AI Mode.

items.original: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash lets you build with more control
items.rewritten: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash offers enhanced control for developers, allowing for more customized building experiences. This tool aims to improve the development process with greater flexibility.

items.original: Fund Momentum MCP: Live VC Fund Data for AI Agents
items.rewritten: Fund Momentum MCP provides real-time data on venture capital funds specifically tailored for AI agents. This service aims to enhance the decision-making capabilities of AI by offering up-to-date financial insights.

items.original: Launch HN: Tokenless (YC S26) – Automatic model switching to save money
items.rewritten: Tokenless is a startup from Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch that offers automatic model switching to help users save money. This feature allows users to optimize their resource usage without needing to manage tokens manually.

items.original: Supporting Thailand’s next generation of AI startups. OpenAI and Thailand’s MHESI launch an eight-week accelerator helping 10 health, wellness, and education startups turn AI prototypes into trusted products.
items.rewritten: OpenAI is collaborating with Thailand's MHESI to support the next generation of AI startups. This initiative includes an eight-week accelerator program designed to help ten startups in health, wellness, and education transform their AI prototypes into reliable products.

items.original: Show HN: Diffusion PDF – A Diffusion Image Model Embedded Entirely in a PDF File
items.rewritten: Diffusion PDF is a tool that integrates a diffusion image model directly into a PDF file. This allows users to create and manipulate images using the diffusion model without needing separate software. It's a convenient way to access advanced image generation capabilities within a familiar file format.

items.original: Aquila Voice Assistant Test Suite for Home Assistant
items.rewritten: The Aquila Voice Assistant Test Suite is a set of tools designed for testing voice assistant functionalities within the Home Assistant platform. It helps developers ensure that voice commands and responses work correctly. This suite aims to streamline the development and debugging processes for voice-enabled home automation.

items.original: Show HN: Draco – A single-binary, self-hostable Firecrawl alternative in Rust
items.rewritten: Draco is a self-hostable alternative to Firecrawl, packaged as a single binary and built using Rust. This tool allows users to run web crawling operations without relying on external services. Its design focuses on simplicity and ease of deployment for developers.

items.original: Show HN: Alyph, a manual transmission for LLM context
items.rewritten: Alyph is a tool designed to enhance the context management of large language models (LLMs) through a manual transmission approach. This means users can have more control over how context is handled during interactions with the model. It aims to improve the overall user experience by allowing for more tailored responses.

dropped.rewritten: A discussion on HN raises the question of whether individuals keep their AI projects hidden from public view. This topic explores the reasons behind the secrecy surrounding AI developments.

dropped.rewritten: OpenAI has decided to end its contract with Cursor after the company was acquired by SpaceX. This decision follows a review of the partnership in light of the acquisition.

dropped.rewritten: Microsoft Research has released Skala 1.1, an updated deep-learning tool that improves the accuracy of predictive density functional theory (DFT). This version enhances accessibility for users in computational chemistry and provides a benchmark for measuring computational performance.

dropped.rewritten: This project explores the process of distilling DeepSeek into GPT-OSS, highlighting that this transformation does not carry over any censorship features.
